title: AuroraJobs
summary: A jobs and career-guidance platform for university students, employers, and career services. I built the full-stack product and gradually took on more technical decisions and coordination.
problem: University students taking their first career steps and companies looking for junior talent rarely meet in a place built for that stage. Generalist job boards treat both as an afterthought.
audience: University students, companies hiring junior talent, and university career centers.
role: Full-Stack Software Engineer. I worked with the CTO and Product, later supporting coordination, task distribution, and code review.
responsibilities: Built the product from zero: student profiles, skills and interests assessment, company job posts, matching engine, application flows, and analytics dashboards for university career centers.
Worked on deployments and product infrastructure alongside the application.
Collaborated with Product and the CTO on scope, feasibility, technical solutions, and delivery.
decisions: Rails monolith for speed across profiles, matching, applications and dashboards.
Pairing and code review to share decisions and maintain delivery pace.
Keep the application, deployments, and infrastructure within one technical context.
outcomes: A live product spanning jobs, employer tools, guidance, content, and analytics.
A full-stack foundation across data modelling, business logic, interface work, testing, and deployments.
contribution: Built the full-stack product and contributed to technical and scope decisions.
proof: A Ruby on Rails monolith serving students, employers, and universities.
Direct work with Product and the CTO from definition through delivery.
Code review and growing coordination support.
confidentialityNote: User, funding, team-size, and infrastructure-scope claims remain private until validated.
